items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: Because I played once with him at Son of Barber.

ctx.x: At that time, that very first one, 1921, Dink Johnson played clarinetti. That's right, yeah. He played little drums. He'd been with Freddie Keppard and his brother Bill. Did you ever play with Dink? A few, like little one nights, you know. When he played piano then, I guess?
Yeah, yeah. Because I played once with him at Son of Barber. He lived up there.
He lived up there. I knew Dink very well when he had a place up by the ballpark, you know. That's right. Yeah, by the ballpark.
